verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Insomnia/Inso CLI automates execution of API tests within Git workflows (insomnia-docs-3, insomnia-docs-39). The CLI is designed for CI: it disables prompts and returns exit codes that pass or fail the workflow, which covers failing the build on regressions (insomnia-docs-53, insomnia-probe-4). Collection runs are supported (insomnia-docs-4). missing for 10: the specific CLI command or syntax for running test collections is not shown (only the lint command is), there is no detail on report or output formats, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of CI test runs.
